每个标的交易日收盘投入50元，允许小数份额；累计收益率=期末市值÷总投入−1，未: Invest RMB 50 at the close on each asset trading day, allowing fractional units. Cumulative return = terminal value / contributions − 1, without annualization.
包含起投日，不含最终估值日的投入。五周年遇非交易日向前取该标的最近交易日；停牌日: Include the start date and exclude contributions on the final valuation date. Use the latest asset trading day on or before the fifth anniversary; skip suspended sessions.
沪深300使用全收益指数H00300，自2004-12-31起，包含回溯历史；黄: CSI 300 uses total-return index H00300 from 2004-12-31, including backfilled history. Gold uses Huaan ETF 518880; Treasuries use Guotai 5-year Treasury ETF 511010.
纳指采用人民币交易的国泰纳斯达克100 QDII ETF 513100，自201: Nasdaq uses RMB-traded Guotai Nasdaq-100 QDII ETF 513100 from its listing on 2013-05-15. Market prices include exchange-rate, tracking and market-premium effects.
513100在2022-01-13按1:5拆分并停牌，当日不投入；拆分后价格乘5: ETF 513100 split 1:5 and suspended trading on 2022-01-13. No purchase is made that day. Post-split prices are multiplied by five. The adjusted feed matches this reconstruction daily; no cash distributions were found through 2025.
国债现金分红按除息日收盘即时再投资，忽略到账等待。忽略交易费用、价差；基金内部费: Treasury distributions are reinvested at the ex-date close, ignoring payment delay. Trading fees and spreads are ignored; internal fund expenses remain reflected in prices.
四资产共同起投区间仍为2013-07-29至2020-12-31，每类1812个: The four-asset common window remains 2013-07-29 to 2020-12-31, with 1,812 observations per asset. The original three-asset comparison retains the previous results.
相邻样本高度重叠，不是独立观察；历史亏损比例不代表未来概率。分布统计始终基于完整: Adjacent observations overlap heavily and are not independent. Historical loss frequencies do not predict future probabilities. Distributions always use full five-year outcomes; playback cards use the current holding date.
回放在停牌日以前收盘价估值，不投入。若最终估值日不同，各卡片注明各自日期。最差5: On suspended sessions, playback carries the prior close without purchasing. Cards show individual terminal dates if they differ. Tail mean uses the worst ceil(N × 5%) observations; standard deviation uses the population convention.
